# Driver onboarding note

New drivers get this note on their first day. Please read it before your first shift and ask your supervisor if anything is unclear.

- Maximum shift length: 9 hours, including a 45-minute break after 4.5 hours of driving.
- Minimum rest between two shifts: 11 hours.
- Maximum consecutive working days: 5.

Your supervisor will show you the depot, the rest room and the time clock. Bring your licence and your badge.
